plan.title: pr:check-closing-keywords misses multi-phase / conditional Closes #N (enterprize#29 false complete)

narratives.Description: pr:check-closing-keywords misses multi-phase / conditional Closes #N (enterprize#29 false complete)
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

Directive documents a **Layer 0** gate: `task pr:check-closing-keywords` (#737) — agents **must** run it in pre-pr before push. It is supposed to stop GitHub auto-close footguns.

On **deftai/enterprize** PR #30 (2026-07-31), the PR body contained:

```text
Closes #29 Phase A intake only if you want intake closed on merge — otherwise leave #29 open for Phase B/C distill.
```

GitHub still matched **`Closes #29`** and closed multi-phase issue **#29** as COMPLETED on squash merge. Phase B/C were **not** done.

## Reproduce (consumer deposit 0.90.0)

```bash
# body file = exact PR #30 body (includes the Closes #29 line above)
task deft:pr:check-closing-keywords -- --body-file /tmp/pr30-body.md --commits-file /tmp/pr30-commits.txt
# → OK: no closing-keyword negation/quotation/example/code-block hits found.
# → exit 0
```

So the gate **passed** while GitHub **would and did** close the issue.

## Root cause (stacked)

| Layer | What happened |
| --- | --- |
| **GitHub** | Closing keywords match `Closes #N` even with trailing prose (“Phase A…”, “only if…”). Conditional English is ignored. |
| **Agent body** | Author wrote `Closes #29…` intending a *partial* phase note. Wrong pattern; should be `Tracking: #29` / no close keyword until full DoD. |
| **Directive Layer 0 (#737)** | Lint scope is **negation / quotation / example / code-block** contexts only (e.g. `DOES NOT CLOSE #734`). A bare/conditional **real** `Closes #N` on a multi-phase umbrella is **out of scope** → exit 0. |
| **Directive Layer 3 (#701)** | `pr:check-protected-issues` only helps if the issue is registered **protected / staying-OPEN**. #29 was a normal multi-phase issue, not protected. |
| **Process** | Pre-pr skill says ! run the lint — even perfect compliance would not have blocked this body. Babysit/merge path does not re-lint body at merge. |

## Failure classes (extend the existing stack)

| Class | Example | Coverage today |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A. Negation / quote FP | `DOES NOT CLOSE #734` | Layer 0 #737 |
| B. Sticky Development link | body fixed, link remains | Layer 3 #701 |
| C. Squash body / commit concat | `Closes` only in commits | #701 + controlled squash body |
| **D. Premature real close** | `Closes #29 Phase A…` | **this issue — gap** |
| E. Should have closed, didn’t | merge with no keyword | Layer 1 #167 verify |

#29 / PR #30 = **class D**. Existing layers target A–C and E, not premature intentional-looking closes.

---

## Proposed fix (Admiral design capture 2026-07-31)

Goal: catch class D **before** it occurs, **at merge**, and **after** with automatic safe repair (reopen — not silent history rewrite).

### Asymmetry

- **Auto-reopen** premature closes = safe default.
- **Auto-close** from heuristics = ⊗ (too dangerous).
- Do not try to change GitHub’s keyword parser.

### P0 — Before (prevention)

#### P0.1 Agent / skill policy

In pre-pr, review-cycle, and scm body helpers:

- Default PR body: `Tracking: #N` / `Related: #N` only.
- `Closes` / `Fixes` / `Resolves #N` only when **full issue DoD** is met.
- ⊗ `Closes #N Phase A` / `only if` / `partial` / conditional English around a real closing keyword.

#### P0.2 Expand Layer 0 into two modes

| Mode | Fail when |
| --- | --- |
| **FP mode** (existing #737) | keyword in negation / quotation / example / code-block |
| **Intent mode** (new) | **any** closing keyword unless explicitly allowlisted |

Allowlist (pick one default-strict; document both):

1. CLI: `--allow-close N,M` on the lint, **or**
2. Machine trailer in PR body, e.g. `deft-close-intent: full`, required beside any `Closes #N`.

Bare / conditional `Closes #N` without allowlist → exit 1.

#### P0.3 CI on every PR

Do not rely on agent memory alone. Workflow step runs FP + intent modes on live PR body + commits.

### P1 — At merge (last mechanical gate)

Wire into `pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge` / finish-loop **before** `gh pr merge`:

1. Re-fetch **live** body + commits + `closingIssuesReferences`.
2. Run FP + intent lints.
3. Run `pr:check-protected-issues` (#701).
4. If sticky bad links: auto-unlink (GraphQL) or fail with exact unlink command.
5. Squash-merge only with explicit `--body-file` (never default squash = commit concat).

Catches body edits after pre-pr and babysit paths that skip skills.

### P1 — After (detect + auto-repair)

#### Post-merge close audit (extend #167)

For each issue closed by / linked from the merged PR:

| Signal | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Unchecked `- [ ]` remaining in issue body / open Phase B–C language | **auto-reopen** + sticky comment |
| Label `multi-phase` / `protected` / `staying-open` | same |
| Machine policy e.g. `deft-close-policy: stay-open-until: …` | same |
| Expected close, still open (class E) | comment + fail audit |

#### Auto-fix playbook (deterministic)

```text
on premature-close detected:
  1. gh issue reopen N
  2. sticky comment: PR #, keyword snippet, policy cite, audit id
  3. optional: note on PR (historical)
  4. triage / product-signal audit row
  5. if running in merge job: exit 1 so the failure is visible
```

#### Optional reconcile

`task pr:audit-closes --since 24h` (or extend `reconcile:issues`) for merges that bypassed the wrapper (UI / raw `gh pr merge`).

### P2 — Hardening

- Auto-label multi-phase / umbrella issues → protected set (Layer 3 always on for them).
- `scm:body:pr:edit` helper: rewrite accidental `Closes` → `Tracking` before merge.
- Lesson row in `meta/lessons.md`: class D ≠ class A; cite enterprize #29 / PR #30.

---

## Implementation order (suggested acceptance slices)

- [ ] **Slice 1 — Policy:** skill + docs ⊗ partial/conditional `Closes`; default `Tracking: #N`
- [ ] **Slice 2 — Intent lint:** any closing keyword fails unless `--allow-close` / `deft-close-intent: full`
- [ ] **Slice 3 — CI:** both lints on PR
- [ ] **Slice 4 — Merge wrapper:** live re-check + sticky unlink + explicit squash body
- [ ] **Slice 5 — Post-merge audit:** checklist / multi-phase / protected → auto-reopen + comment
- [ ] **Slice 6 — Protect multi-phase by default** + optional rewrite helper + lessons

Each slice independently valuable; P0 slices stop recurrence even without auto-reopen.

## Tests / fixtures

- [ ] Fixture body = enterprize PR #30 text → intent mode **exit 1**
- [ ] Same body → FP mode still exit 0 (documents class split)
- [ ] `Closes #N` + `deft-close-intent: full` (or allowlist) → exit 0
- [ ] `DOES NOT CLOSE #N` → FP mode exit 1 (no regression on #735)
- [ ] Post-merge audit: issue with open checkbox closed by PR → reopen path (hermetic)

## Actual (incident)

Layer 0 green + merge → GitHub closed enterprize #29 COMPLETED; manual reopen/re-close + clean follow-up required.

## Evidence

- enterprize PR #30 body (merged)
- enterprize #29 closed at `2026-07-31T21:06:32Z` by merge event
- Pre-pr skill Phase 4 Diff requires `task pr:check-closing-keywords` (#737); recurrence stack #167 / #697 / #698 / #401 / #700 / #735
- Live check exit 0 on the offending body (0.90.0 consumer)
- Design discussion: Admiral + Number One 2026-07-31 (~18:28–18:36 CDT)

## Related

- #737 Layer 0 lint (FP / negation)
- #701 protected issues (Layer 3)
- #167 post-merge close verify (Layer 1)
- #735 squash `DOES NOT CLOSE` (class A — different from this class D)
- enterprize #29 (Phase A intake; premature complete)
- enterprize #34 (clean hardening follow-up; not a reopen of #29)
- enterprize PR #30

## Non-goals

- Changing GitHub’s keyword parser (out of our control)
- Auto-closing issues from heuristics
- Silent rewrite of git/GitHub history to hide a bad close


---

## Update (2026-07-31 ~18:36 CDT)

Issue body expanded with Admiral-facing design:

- Failure **class D** (premature real close) vs existing A–C/E stack
- Fix stack: **before** (policy + intent-mode lint + CI) · **at merge** (live re-check / sticky unlink / explicit squash body) · **after** (auto-**reopen** premature closes — not auto-close heuristics)
- P0→P2 slices + fixture acceptance
- Asymmetry: reopen safe; auto-close from heuristics forbidden
